headlines.headline: Supreme Court Strikes Down IEEPA Tariffs 6-3 — $168B Collected Now Subject to Refund
headlines.driver: For XLI: Positive — legal reset removed emergency tariffs and triggered XLI +2.1% relief rally; forced shift to 301 gives XLI more durable, predictable protection than IEEPA's emergency basis.

headlines.headline: Markets Rally on Tariff Reset — XLI +2.1%, XLB +1.8% as IEEPA Voided
headlines.driver: For XLI: Positive — voided IEEPA lifted XLI more than XLB on relief, showing XLI is more sensitive to tariff-policy certainty than commodity price alone.
